name: speakr-blog-pipeline
description: End-to-end blog content pipeline. Smart GDrive onboarding (knows Speakr's canonical folder structure: Brand Blueprint, IP STACK, Branding book, Competitive Analysis, Blogs, Testimonials, Keynotes — pulls and parses each into the right destination). Recurring drive-sync skill refreshes voice DNA as clients add content. Voice always wins over formatting rules. Strict text → graphics → preview → publish ordering. Styled HTML preview. Auto-publishes to Webflow/WordPress after preview approval. Per-colleague client isolation.
